newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kirin Brewery, Taiwan firm to make beer in China.
newsitem.headline: Kirin Brewery, Taiwan firm to make beer in China.

text.p: Japan's largest beer maker, Kirin Brewery Co Ltd, said on Wednesday it has set up a joint venture with Taiwanese food firm President Enterprises Corp to produce beer in China.
The new firm, Zhuhai Kirin President Brewery Co Ltd, is capitalised at $29.5 million and 60 percent held by Kirin and the rest by two units of the Taiwanese company.
The joint venture will purchase production facilities and business rights from a Chinese brewery in Guangdong Province in December, Kirin said in a statement.
The facility currently has a production capacity of 60,000 kilolitres of beer a year, the statement said.
The new firm is expected to start producing Kirin beer in late 1997, it said.
Kirin has licensed 15 plants in China to produce its beer since May 1995.
Another major Japanese brewer, Asahi Breweries Ltd, also hopes to locally produce its mainstay brand, Super Dry, in China, possibly starting by the end of next year.
